items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I got Benny Glass the lawyer to go out there and kind of get him out of all that trouble

ctx.x: She set the place on fire again out there and the saxaphone player found it and she say, "I'm going to burn it down." Second time, see? So then he kept fooling around and the saxaphone player laid on it and she set it on fire again and I got Benny Glass the lawyer to go out there and kind of get him out of all that trouble, because he was in the oil business and the bakery business. Young fella from Florida.
So that's what I was doing during those days. I played about nine places out there. I played for Lisa's and
